'''Patrick O'Bryant'''  is an [[NCAA]] [[basketball]] player who is projected to be a [[lottery pick]] in the [[2006 NBA Draft]].  His impressive performance in the NCAA tournament made NBA scouts notice him.

He was a classic late bloomer who was not heavily recruited out of high school.

O'Bryant was suspended for the first eight games of his sophomore season by the NCAA because he was getting paid for work he did not do on his summer job.
